text:
claire_sales: Procurement at LumenWorks sent an urgent request: they need an assurance bundle for the POC by next Friday COB. Ask list: SOC2 Type II (redacted ok), ISO27001 cert, signed pen-test attestation (they prefer notarized, but e-sign acceptable), short network diagram, KMS key handling statement, and a note on whether external vulnerability scans against staging will be allowed. Any major blockers?

maria_security: We can assemble SOC2 + ISO cert PDFs quickly. For the pen-test attestation, we can draft an attestation letter and provide a redacted summary of the last third-party test (counts by CVSS bucket + short remediation paragraph). Notarization will add time. Also need to know if they want prod scope or POC/staging only.

claire_sales: They specified POC/staging only. They wrote: "We need these artifacts to complete vendor due diligence for a timeboxed POC. Notarized letter preferred but DocuSign ok."

kevin_legal: Legal can sign the attestation electronically same-day. Notarization requires signatory details and ~3 business days for coordination. If they accept e-sign, we should avoid delay. Also advise: any wording promising no outstanding critical vulns should be carefully scoped. Provide standard language and I will approve.

ian_eng: Operationally, if they want to run external scans on our staging, we need a scan scope form filled, approved IP ranges, and a maintenance window. We cannot expose shared production endpoints for customer scans. If they require isolated staging (dedicated pool), that impacts cost and provisioning time.

claire_sales: They asked whether a short-lived dedicated pool for the POC is possible and how much extra it would cost. Can someone give a ballpark?

ian_eng: Ballpark: single A10-equivalent dedicated instance for 2 weeks ≈ +$3k-$4k depending on token usage. Additional ops time for isolation and IP mapping ~ 3-5 hours. If they ask for customer-managed KMS for Private, that is a separate onboarding workstream.

maria_security: Draft pen-test attestation suggestion:

"Redwood Inference, Inc. attests that third-party penetration testing is conducted at least annually against production services and that scoped assessments are performed on staging/dedicated environments upon customer request. As of (DATE), there were no outstanding critical vulnerabilities in the scoped POC/staging environment. A redacted summary of the most recent external assessment (CVSS bucket counts) can be provided under NDA."

maria_security: KMS snippet we can include:

"Keys: Data at rest is encrypted using AES-256. Keys are managed via AWS KMS with automatic rotation every 365 days. For Redwood Private deployments, customers may provide their own CMK where supported; please contact solutions for required steps."

kevin_legal: I'll review and finalize attestation language and prepare DocuSign-ready PDF. If procurement insists on notarization, ask for signatory name, title, and jurisdiction.

ops-bot: TICKET-9012 created: "lumenworks poc assurance request - notarization option" assigned to security/legal/ops. Link: https://issues.redwood.internal/TICKET-9012

claire_sales: Action items: (1) Maria: assemble SOC2 redacted + ISO cert + draft attestation and redacted vuln summary, (2) Kevin: prepare e-sign and note notarization path, (3) Ian: confirm ops delta for isolated staging and provide price delta, (4) Claire: confirm with procurement if e-sign acceptable or notarization required. Target: assemble draft packet by Thu EOD to leave time for signature.

maria_security: Will prepare drafts today and loop legal. Marking any items requiring NDA.

kevin_legal: Noted. I can sign as General Counsel; will request procurement contact if notarization required.

claire_sales: Thanks team. I'll update procurement and ask whether they need the raw vuln data (they likely don't). If they do, we'll require NDA and a separate secure transfer. :thumbsup:
